oracleAgreement.description: Mean fraction of spec lines equal to the synthetic oracle (same rulebook applied to the latent taste). 95% bootstrap CI.

exactOracleMatch.description: Share of briefs where every line equals the oracle. Wilson 95% CI.

latentTasteRecovery.description: Does the fingerprint's top atmosphere appear in the client's true top-2? (B3 evidence)

constraintViolationRate.description: Warm-word lighting briefs whose colour temperature goes cooler than 3000K ambient.

writtenRangeViolationRate.description: Briefs where the client wrote a colour-temperature range: share whose spec has any colour temperature outside it. B2 (evidence only) is not given the range, by design.

personalizationSensitivity.description: Same words, different latent taste. justifiedDifferenceRate = differing lines where each side equals its own oracle.

irrelevantInputStability.description: Reordered loves, renamed client, case/spacing changes: identical spec (before clarification).

clarification.note: The synthetic client answers by its latent truth, which is the best case for asking. Real clients are noisier.

latencyMs.description: End-to-end runBrief on the in-process synthetic transport: orchestration cost only, not network latency.

evidenceCompleteness.description: Spec lines with a basis, and (for Qloo-evidence lines) cited dimensions, ledger requests and signal entities.

oracle.dimming: Full-range dimming to 1% and three scenes (day / dinner / late).
oracle.level: Ambient at the low end: ~100 lux; let accent and lamps carry the room. (Typical 100–200 lux for this room; confirm with a lighting calculation.)
oracle.optics: Narrow 15–25° accent beams on art and tables; glare shielding on every downlight.
oracle.cri: CRI 95+ with R9 > 50, so wood, skin and food read true.
